technical.summary: Strong short-term bullish confluence (9/21 EMA cross, Stoch cross, Ichimoku TK cross) with rising momentum indicators, but weak intermediate/long-term trend structure (below 200-MA, low ADX) and overbought conditions limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: CMI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest with earnings in 14 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: No current congressional signal; market in fear zone (36/100) with bearish AAII sentiment (46.5%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but stale congressional data (2+ years old) and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (349.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 14 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for CMI.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term technical confluence (9/21 EMA golden cross, Stoch bullish cross, Ichimoku TK cross) with rising momentum provides a valid swing entry signal near support at 179.36.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R), price below 200-EMA/50-SMA, weak ADX (16.64), high earnings risk in 14 days, crisis VIX, and zero fundamental/smart money support make this a low-conviction, high-risk entry in an unfavourable macro environment.

decision.entry_rationale: While short-term technicals show a valid 9/21 EMA golden cross and Stoch bullish confluence near support, the setup is undermined by overbought momentum, price below 200-EMA, weak ADX trend strength, and earnings risk in 14 days.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 14 days combined with crisis VIX (349.6), overbought conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R), and zero fundamental/smart money support create unacceptable risk-reward for a swing entry.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding CMI with 43 existing Industrials positions (14% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further.
